[LGRA.2.5.1] Identifier and type-symbol terminals:

```
NAME     ::= <one identifier terminal over the XID class,
             NFC-normalized; legality per [LNAM.2.2], lexer
             realization per [LLEX]>
TYPE_SYM ::= <the type-symbol terminal: the NAME class plus the non-XID unit
             glyphs (`°` `′` `″`, …); valid only in type positions
             ([LGRA.22]); lexer realization per [LLEX]>
NULLABLE ::= '?'                                # the nullable-type marker ([LNUL])
```
